# ==============================================================================
# T1-A: POST-WAR OVERSEAS CONQUEST HANDOVER (oe_col4.1)
# ==============================================================================
oe_col4.1 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	title = oe_col4.1.t
	desc = oe_col4.1.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v185_grand_peace_treaty_harbor.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		exists = scope:oe_col4_region
		exists = scope:target_colony
	}

	# Option A: Hand over all newly conquered non-core lands in this region to target_colony
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.1.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.1.a.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 85 }
		oe_col4_transfer_region_to_colony = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target_colony }
			scope:target_colony = {
				oe_col4_apply_unified_colonial_name = yes
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_col4_viceroy_grant_mod
					years = 5
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Option B: Keep coastal ports as Crown maritime stations, transfer inland territories
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.1.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.1.b.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
		oe_col4_transfer_inland_to_colony = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target_colony }
			scope:target_colony = {
				oe_col4_apply_unified_colonial_name = yes
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_crown_enclave_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	# Option C: Retain direct Crown administration over all conquered holdings
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.1.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.1.c.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 5 }
		add_prestige = 3
	}
}

oe_col4.11 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = negative
	title = oe_col4.11.t
	desc = oe_col4.11.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v180_columbian_harvest_plague.dds"

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations >= 2
		any_owned_location = {
			is_capital = no
			population < 2.5
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				is_capital = no
				population < 2.5
			}
			save_scope_as = depop_loc
		}
	}

	# Abandon stricken frontier settlement to regroup survivors
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.11.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.11.a.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 85 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:depop_loc }
			abandon_location = scope:depop_loc
		}
		add_stability = 2
	}

	# Spend treasury & stability to hold the frontier settlement
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.11.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.11.b.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 15 }
		add_stability = -4
		add_gold = -25
	}
}

	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	title = oe_col4.20.t
	desc = oe_col4.20.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_nav2_treasure_fleet.dds"

		is_rebel_country = no

	# Option A: Charter formal Colonial Viceroyalty (Recommended)

		name = oe_col4.20.a

		ai_chance = { base = 90 }
		add_gold = -50
		add_prestige = 8
		oe_col4_charter_conquistador_viceroyalty = yes

	# Option B: Extend frontier army mandate (keep campaigning)

		name = oe_col4.20.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.20.b.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 10 }
		scope:conq_subject = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_col4_conq_cd value = 1 days = 1825 }
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# T3: GLOBAL COLUMBIAN EXCHANGE 2.0 — CROPS & LIVESTOCK (oe_col4.30-31)
# ==============================================================================
oe_col4.30 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	title = oe_col4.30.t
	desc = oe_col4.30.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v160_ned_voc_harbor.dds"

	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }

	immediate = {
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_col4_valid_ow_staple_loc = yes }
			save_scope_as = ce_staple_loc
		}
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_col4_valid_ow_cashcrop_loc = yes }
			save_scope_as = ce_cash_loc
		}
	}

	# Option A: Potato & Maize Staple Revolution
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.30.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.30.a.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:ce_staple_loc }
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:ce_staple_loc = {
						OR = {
							climate = continental
							climate = oceanic
						}
					}
				}
				scope:ce_staple_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:potato }
			}
			else = {
				scope:ce_staple_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:maize }
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_ce_staple_boom_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	# Option B: Tobacco & Cocoa Cash-Crop Charter
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.30.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.30.b.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:ce_cash_loc }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:ce_cash_loc = { climate = tropical } }
				scope:ce_cash_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:cocoa }
			}
			else = {
				scope:ce_cash_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:tobacco }
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_ce_cashcrop_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}

oe_col4.31 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	title = oe_col4.31.t
	desc = oe_col4.31.d
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v160_ned_voc_harbor.dds"

	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }

	immediate = {
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_col4_valid_nw_ranch_loc = yes }
			save_scope_as = ce_ranch_loc
		}
		random_owned_location = {
			limit = { oe_col4_valid_nw_plantation_loc = yes }
			save_scope_as = ce_plant_loc
		}
	}

	# Option A: Eurasian Horses & Cattle Ranching
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.31.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.31.a.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 55 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:ce_ranch_loc }
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:ce_ranch_loc = {
						OR = {
							climate = hot_semi_arid
							climate = cold_semi_arid
							climate = continental
						}
					}
				}
				scope:ce_ranch_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:horses }
			}
			else = {
				scope:ce_ranch_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:livestock }
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_ce_ranching_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	# Option B: Sugar, Coffee & Wheat Estates
	option = {
		name = oe_col4.31.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_col4.31.b.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:ce_plant_loc }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:ce_plant_loc = { climate = tropical } }
				scope:ce_plant_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:sugar }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:ce_plant_loc = { climate = subtropical } }
				scope:ce_plant_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:coffee }
			}
			else = {
				scope:ce_plant_loc = { change_raw_material = goods:wheat }
			}
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_col4_ce_plantation_mod
			years = 10
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}
